## WorkerThreadInit.createGatewayServer() method

Create a gateway server for inter-worker communication.

**Signature:**

```typescript
createGatewayServer(register?: any, path?: string): Promise<boolean>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;boolean&gt;

Promise that resolves to `true` when gateway is ready.

## Example


```typescript
// Recommended - uses default `this` and static gatewayServerPath
await this.createGatewayServer();

// Custom object and path
await this.createGatewayServer(
  { ping: () => "pong" },
  "/tmp/my-worker.sock"
);
```
